SELECT DISTINCT 
CLM.CLM_ID AS CLAIM_ID,
CASE
	WHEN DNU.CEV_CLM_ID IS NULL AND UNC.CER_CLM_ID IS NULL AND UNL.CSER_CSV_CLM_ID IS NULL AND ADJ.CRS_CLM_ID IS NULL THEN 'Valid Encounter'
	WHEN DNU.CEV_CLM_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'Denied Claim with unclean message'
	WHEN UNC.CER_CLM_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'Unclean Message'
	WHEN UNL.CSER_CSV_CLM_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'Unclean Message'
	WHEN ADJ.CRS_CLM_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'Adjusted'
END	AS "Encounter SLA Exclusion Reason"

FROM		HS.CLM_CLAIM   AS CLM
JOIN		HS.CDT_CLM_DT  AS CDT ON CLM.CLM_ID = CDT.CDT_CLM_ID AND CDT.CDT_DT_QUAL = '050' AND CDT.CDT_DT >= CURRENT_DATE - 2 YEAR
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DN.CEV_CLM_ID FROM HS.CEV_CLM_EV AS DN 
							JOIN HS.CAU_CLM_AUD	AS CAU ON DN.CEV_CLM_ID = CAU.CAU_CLM_ID AND CAU.CAU_TYPE = 'NC'
							WHERE DN.CEV_DEL_TS IS NULL AND DN.CEV_RUN_ID IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(DN.CEV_TYPE) = 'DN' AND DN.CEV_ADD_TS = (SELECT CEV_ADD_TS FROM HS.CEV_CLM_EV WHERE DN.CEV_CLM_ID = CEV_CLM_ID AND CEV_DEL_TS IS NULL ORDER BY CEV_ADD_TS DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY WITH UR)
			WITH UR) AS DNU ON CLM.CLM_ID = DNU.CEV_CLM_ID
LEFT JOIN (SELECT CER.CER_CLM_ID FROM HS.CER_CLM_ERROR AS CER WHERE CER.CER_CD IN (557,592,1386,1387,1385,8005,8006,8016,3983) WITH UR) AS UNC ON CLM.CLM_ID = UNC.CER_CLM_ID
LEFT JOIN (SELECT CSER.CSER_CSV_CLM_ID FROM HS.CSER_CSV_ERROR AS CSER WHERE CSER.CSER_CD IN (557,592,1386,1387,1385,8005,8006,8016,3983) WITH UR) AS UNL ON CLM.CLM_ID = UNL.CSER_CSV_CLM_ID
LEFT JOIN (SELECT CRS_CLM_ID FROM HS.CRS_CLM_RESULT WHERE CRS_TYPE = '077' AND CRS_DEL_TS IS NULL WITH UR) AS ADJ ON CLM.CLM_ID = ADJ.CRS_CLM_ID

WITH UR
